Population increased in Hounslow

The estimated population of Hounslow in 2024 was 299,424 usual residents, a rise of 1.4% since 2023.

This meant that Hounslow's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Hounslow increased by 3.9%.

Over this slightly longer period, Hounslow was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Hounslow

The average (median) age fell to 36.9 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Hounslow has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Hounslow is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Hounslow's population of 299,424 usual residents was made up of:

  • 59,828 people aged 0 to 15 years, (20%)
  • 202,972 people aged 16 to 64 years, (67.8%)
  • 36,624 people aged 65 years and over, (12.2%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Hounslow has a lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (12.2% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Hounslow, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Hounslow
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Hounslow, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 2,051 people (0.7%). In total, there were 3,678 births and 1,627 deaths in Hounslow.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 6,674 (-2.3%). There were 22,205 people entering the area and 28,879 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Hounslow's population of 8,847 (3%) as a result of 12,803 people entering the area and 3,956 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Hounslow was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Hounslow in mid-2023 is 295,221.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 195 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 680 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 485 people.
